categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen JPT Opto-Electronics Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of lasers, laser/optical intelligent equipment, and optical fiber devices. The company focuses on high-power pulsed fiber lasers (MOPA), continuous fiber lasers, solid-state lasers, and ultrafast lasers, serving industries such as consumer electronics, semiconductor, photovoltaic, and new energy batteries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include adjustable pulse width high-power pulsed fiber lasers (MOPA), laser and optical intelligent equipment integrating laser sources, precision measurement, motion control, machine vision, and software algorithms. Production methods combine make-to-order and batch production, with strict quality control and use of Oracle EBS management system for production planning and execution.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global companies in consumer electronics, semiconductors, optoelectronic components, and new energy batteries such as Apple, Meta, Intel, CATL, BYD, and others. The company serves markets in laser precision processing, optical detection, photovoltaic cells, passive components, and flexible printed circuit boards.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Shenzhen and subsidiaries in Singapore, Korea, Japan, Taiwan, and the United States. Its products and services cover Asia, North America, and Europe, with significant domestic sales growth and some overseas sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: JPT operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing core laser devices and intelligent laser/optical equipment used by downstream manufacturers in electronics, semiconductors, and new energy sectors. It also supplies optical fiber components and provides integrated laser solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in laser technology, focusing on high-power and ultrafast lasers tailored for lithium batteries, photovoltaics, consumer electronics, and semiconductor precision processing. R&D efforts include developing intelligent laser/optical equipment with integrated measurement and control modules, expanding into new fields like XR, flexible circuits, and perovskite solar cells. It maintains a strong patent portfolio and invests over 11% of revenue in R&D.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of laser products, laser/optical intelligent equipment, and optical fiber devices to domestic and international customers. The company engages in customized product development in collaboration with clients, especially for laser/optical intelligent equipment, and operates a direct sales model without intermediaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: JPT is a leading domestic manufacturer and the first in China to commercialize adjustable pulse width high-power pulsed fiber lasers (MOPA). It competes with international companies dominating laser precision processing and optical detection equipment markets. The company leverages technology innovation and cost advantages to increase domestic market share and aims to replace imported equipment in several segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, JPT achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.45 billion, an 18.6% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 132.7 million, up 23.5%. Total assets reached RMB 2.76 billion, growing 8.2%. The company maintains steady growth driven by expanding sales in new energy, consumer electronics, and optical detection sectors, with ongoing investments in R&D and production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: JPT emphasizes advanced laser technology with adjustable pulse width, high power stability, and compact design, enabling high precision and efficiency in laser processing. Its integrated laser and optical intelligent equipment combine proprietary laser sources with precision measurement, motion control, and machine vision, offering customized solutions that improve customer productivity and reduce costs. The company’s domestic production capability and innovation help customers achieve import substitution and enhanced supply chain security.
